UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Account profile for a Candidate (Job Seeker) or Employer (Recruiter) on Nature Island Careers.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

name.description: Full legal name of the candidate or primary contact person for the employer.

accountType.description: Non-privileged account type: candidate or employer.

parish.description: Dominica parish of residence or headquarters.

dssRegistrationNo.description: Dominica Social Security employer registration number.

skills.description: Bounded list of up to 10 key professional skills.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last updated.

EmailCategorySubscription.title: EmailCategorySubscription
EmailCategorySubscription.description: Email job category subscription linked to an authenticated user account for automated Dominica vacancy notifications.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the subscription owner.

email.description: Recipient email address for job category alerts.

categories.description: Bounded list of up to 10 subscribed Dominica job categories/sectors.

parishes.description: Bounded list of up to 11 Dominica parishes.

active.description: Whether automated notifications are currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated account profile data for candidates and employers, strictly accessible only by the document owner.

/users/{userId}/emailSubscriptions/{subs.description: Stores email job category alert subscriptions per verified user for automated vacancy notifications.
